description: The capital of Saudi Arabia, home to the historic Diriyah district and the Masmak Fortress, blending Najdi heritage with a modern skyline.
A vast open-air museum in northwest Saudi Arabia, home to Hegra, Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, and thousands of years of Arabian civilization.
The historic gateway to Makkah on the Red Sea coast, known for the UNESCO-listed Al-Balad old town with its coral-stone tower houses.
A mountain city known as the 'City of Roses', historically a summer retreat with terraced gardens and Ottoman-era architecture.
The capital of the Asir Region, set in the Sarawat Mountains, known for terraced villages, misty highlands, and vibrant Asiri folk art.
A major Eastern Province city near ancient Dilmun civilization sites and the historic Qatif oasis.
